name: Acko
description: Acko is a digital-first insurance company offering motor, health, and travel insurance products through a fully online platform.

name: NSE (National Stock Exchange)
description: National Stock Exchange of India is the largest stock exchange in India by trading volume, operating equity, derivatives, and debt markets.

name: Reliance Jio
description: Reliance Jio Infocomm is India's largest telecom operator with 450M+ subscribers, offering 4G/5G services, broadband, and digital platforms.

name: OYO
description: OYO (Oravel Stays) is a global hospitality company offering budget and premium hotels, vacation homes, and co-living spaces across 35+ countries.

name: Parle Products
description: Parle Products is India's leading biscuit manufacturer known for brands like Parle-G, Monaco, Hide & Seek, and Melody.

name: MakeMyTrip
description: MakeMyTrip is India's largest online travel company offering flights, hotels, holiday packages, and bus bookings. Listed on NASDAQ, planning India listing.
purpose: India listing for domestic investor access

name: BOAT
description: boAt is India's #1 audio wearables brand selling earphones, headphones, smartwatches, and speakers. Backed by Qualcomm and Warburg Pincus.

name: Zepto
description: Zepto is a quick-commerce platform delivering groceries and essentials in 10 minutes across major Indian cities. Valued at $5B+.

name: PhonePe
description: PhonePe is India's leading UPI payments platform with 500M+ registered users, also offering mutual funds, insurance, and lending products.

name: Flipkart
description: Flipkart is India's largest e-commerce platform (owned by Walmart) competing with Amazon India across electronics, fashion, groceries, and more.

name: Hero Fincorp
description: Hero FinCorp is an NBFC providing two-wheeler loans, personal loans, SME financing, and loan against property. Part of the Hero Group.

name: SBI Mutual Fund
description: SBI Mutual Fund is India's largest AMC by AUM, managing ₹10+ lakh crore across equity, debt, and hybrid schemes.

name: Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages
description: HCCB is the largest bottling partner of Coca-Cola in India, manufacturing and distributing Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Fanta, Maaza and other brands.

name: Zetwerk
description: Zetwerk is a B2B manufacturing marketplace connecting buyers with manufacturers for custom fabrication, machining, and metal components.

name: Bajaj Energy
description: Bajaj Energy is a thermal power generation company in Uttar Pradesh, operating coal-based power plants with 2,430 MW installed capacity.

name: Kent RO Systems
description: Kent RO Systems is a leading water purifier brand in India, also manufacturing air purifiers, vacuum cleaners, and kitchen appliances.

name: Cult.fit
description: Cult.fit is a health and fitness platform offering gym memberships, group workouts, yoga, nutrition plans, and mental wellness programs.

name: FabIndia
description: FabIndia is a retail brand for handcrafted clothing, furniture, organic foods, and personal care products sourced from traditional artisans.

name: Milky Mist
description: Milky Mist is a South Indian dairy brand known for paneer, curd, lassi, butter, and cheese. One of the largest private dairy companies in Tamil Nadu.

name: Shiprocket
description: Shiprocket is India's largest e-commerce logistics aggregator, providing shipping, fulfilment, and returns management for D2C brands and SMBs.

name: PayU
description: PayU is an online payment gateway in India processing digital transactions for merchants, offering EMI options, and credit products.
